get.description: Retrieve details of a specific contract change using the change ID. This endpoint provides information about the contract change, including its status and any associated line item changes.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to retrieve.

patch.description: Update a specific contract change in your HubSpot account by providing the change ID. This operation allows you to modify details of an existing contract change, such as line item changes or the effective date. It requires a valid change ID and a request body with the necessary update details.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to update.

post.description: Accept a specific contract change in the HubSpot commerce system. This endpoint is used when a proposed change to a contract needs to be formally accepted. It requires the unique identifier of the change to be accepted.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to accept.

post.description: Cancel a specific contract change in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to cancel a change that has been proposed or is in draft status, effectively preventing it from being applied to the contract.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to cancel.

post.description: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the Commerce Contracts Public API. This endpoint allows you to specify various contract details, including billing information, line items, and payment methods. A successful operation returns the URL of the newly created contract resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the details of a specific contract using its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for accessing contract information such as status, line items, and associated billing details. It requires the contract ID to be specified in the path.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify contract details by providing the necessary data in the request body. Use this endpoint to make changes to contracts, such as updating billing information or adjusting contract terms.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to update.

get.description: Retrieve a list of changes associated with a specific contract. This endpoint is useful for tracking modifications or updates made to a contract over time. It provides detailed information about each change, allowing users to monitor the evolution of contract terms and conditions.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which changes are being retrieved.

post.description: Create a new change for a specific contract in the HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to propose modifications to an existing contract, which may include changes to line items or other contract details. The request must include the necessary details for the change, and upon successful creation, a URL to the newly created resource will be provided.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the change is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Create a renewal quote for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to generate a quote for contract renewal using a specified quote template. It is useful for managing contract renewals and ensuring continuity of services or products.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the renewal quote is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Terminate a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the contract ID and a termination date. It is useful for ending contracts that are no longer needed or have been fulfilled.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to terminate.
